The bar is 2 because the smallest real build in this corpus touches one component with a proofs/ peer and crosses one gate.

intention: constrain hands the builder the answers it would otherwise go and fetch — starting with the instruments that will judge this work, DISCOVERED rather than listed, RUN rather than named, and reported with their state right now — so that a lookup happens once in the floor instead of N times in the ceiling.
why:
AKIEN'S, 2026-08-14, verbatim, and the four clauses are load-bearing in order: 'that sounds like a plan. so the intention is this component can give you the same kinds and amounts of information you'd give youself. that it replaces those tool calls for you. why: because we can. because it gets us measurably closer to running those components for you and without you. and to keep learning, not to become fixed. because it's an easy one to get right before moving mon to harder ones.'

MEASURED behind it, over this session's own transcript, n=1 on a complete recorded build: 1251 tool calls, of which 924 are Bash. 681 of those 924 (73%) are lookups in the tree or runs of a standing check — reads, not work. 300 Bash calls re-asked an address already asked in the same session; 169 distinct addresses were looked up and 35 of them four or more times (transitions.py 26x, orient.py 13x, inspector.py 11x). A settled answer re-derived is Law 1's defect by definition, and this is it counted rather than asserted.

THE REFRAME, and it is what makes this constrain's work rather than a caching idea: everything that actually constrained this morning's build was PHYSICS, and constrain collects exclusively PROSE. The entry gate that refused the BUILDME crossing, the judge that refused all six constraint sources, the rung move that had silently retired a fixture's world — none of them appear in any charter's falsifier text, and all three were met by tripping over them after the work was done. So the question changes from 'what bounds this?' to 'what will refuse this?' — a lookup, which is what makes it a floor question. A charter's falsifier is a TRANSLATION of a constraint; the check that enforces it IS the constraint (Law 4), and a constraint that is a runnable check can be RUN at stage 2 rather than quoted.
traces_to: Akien's ruling of 2026-08-14 on constrain's intention (quoted whole in `why`) — the intention itself is his and this ticket implements it rather than proposing it.

Ruling 2026-08-14-the-preamble-compiles-to-learn-not-to-be-cheap — the build order is his: orient, then constrain, then survey, and the other four wait on these three WORKING. This is the constrain rung deepened, and it precedes survey.
Law 1 — the resolver is spent on the novel, not on re-deriving the settled. 300 re-asked addresses in one session is that defect counted.
Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy. The reframe IS this law: the check that enforces a bound is the bound, and the prose is its translation.
Law 3 — nothing is known until measured. 'Is this check currently green' is answerable only by running it, which is why the floor runs rather than names.
gates: IN: constrain's floor gains discovered, RUN checks as constraints of a NEW KIND (no new packet field — these ARE constraints, and a constraint whose source is a runnable check is the same thing said in physics); the crowding-out probe's predicate is corrected to ask the floor which kinds it produces instead of spelling 'charter' as a literal; proofs for both; constrain's charter. THREE BOUNDS ON THE IMPLEMENTATION: (1) THE SET IS DISCOVERED AT FIRE TIME FROM DISK, never enumerated — Akien's third clause, and a check that appears next month must appear in the packet with no edit. (2) THE FLOOR RUNS WHAT IS REACHABLE FROM THE REFS AND SAYS HOW IT CHOSE — the tester alone is 106 proofs and a preamble that costs more than the build is a worse answer than the lookups it replaced. (3) THE FLOOR READS VERDICTS AND GATES NOTHING; the crossings keep their own authority (Law 6). OUT and stated: the four other categories CC proposed and Akien did not scope (measurements of the changed data, precedent-transfer, recent rulings, interop contracts) — each is a separate rung and the first to earn a measurement gets built next; survey and the rest of the chain; the dial; anything on hex.local; and any change to a judging component to make it easier to discover — the floor adapts to the instruments, never the reverse.
falsifier: DONE when a constrain packet berths carrying checks the floor DISCOVERED and RAN, at least one of them reported with a state the floor measured rather than assumed, and the crowding-out probe's arithmetic no longer counts those checks as the ceiling's contribution. THREE HOLLOW PASSES, each with its tooth: (1) THE FLOOR EMITS A LIST OF CHECK NAMES — that is a briefing, it is what the charter prose already was, and it passes any test that counts entries. The tooth requires a check reported as judging this build to be one that ACTUALLY RUNS at its crossing, proved by taking a check the floor named and confirming the same identity appears in a real crossing's record. (2) THE FLOOR REPORTS EVERY CHECK GREEN BECAUSE IT NEVER RAN THEM. The tooth mutates the tree — break something a discovered check covers — and requires the floor's report to go red for that check and stay green for the others; a report that cannot go red is the constant this component already shipped once and caught. (3) THE LIST IS A HAND-WRITTEN CONSTANT THAT HAPPENS TO BE RIGHT TODAY. The tooth adds a proof file at a ref'd address in a fixture and requires it to APPEAR in the floor's output with no code change. WRONG INTENT if an oracle is consulted anywhere on this path — bin/cmd/determinism must keep reading this component PURE DETERMINISTIC and REFUSES GATE.
horizon: One build, and it is bounded by the checks half only. The three follow-on categories are named OUT above and each owes its own measurement before it is built.
dependencies: MEASURED, not assumed: every discovery source this needs already exists and already reports its own failures. The proofs are discoverable by their own convention (*/proofs/test_*.py, which bin/cmd/test already walks); the standing commands in bin/cmd are chartered and the derivation gate already proves every one of them is named by a charter; build_inspector's sieves already fire at every PROVEME crossing; the BUILDME entry gate already runs three checks and names all its findings in one pass. NOTHING NEW HAS TO BE BUILT TO KNOW WHAT WILL JUDGE A BUILD — build_inspector's charter has carried this as filed edge (m) since 2026-08-13, in Akien's words 'SAME PATTERN EVERYWHERE'. What is missing is the asking.

NAMED RATHER THAN ASSUMED AWAY: no instrument today reports its state CHEAPLY. 'Is this check currently green' means running it, and the run cost is the real bound on this build — it is gate (2), not a risk to discover later.

CARRIES the parked sibling's WATCHME obligation into a charted voyage. constrain-floor-authors-and-provenance-is-measured stands at TICKETME with its code shipped and its crowding-out probe armed; that probe's predicate is MECHANICALLY WRONG the moment this build lands, and fixing it is IN scope here rather than a child — see distinctions.
NOT a dependency: hex.local. NOT a dependency: any change to skills/chart/dial.py.
distinctions_recorded: THIS VOYAGE IS CHARTED BEFORE IT IS BUILT, AND THAT IS THE CORRECTION IT CARRIES. Its sibling constrain-floor-authors-and-provenance-is-measured was built first and cast afterwards, so its BUILDME crossing was refused by its own entry gate and it stands parked at TICKETME with working, proved, sealed code. The available fix there was to run /chart retroactively, which is plaster — berths written after the build satisfy the check without establishing the thing it checks for (Law 8's hollow pass). So the order is corrected going FORWARD, on this voyage, rather than laundered backward on that one.

THE MECHANICAL COLLISION WAS FOUND BEFORE BUILDING RATHER THAN AFTER, which is the whole argument for the preamble in one instance. The crowding-out probe armed hours earlier counts non-charter constraints as 'the ceiling's contribution'. The moment this floor emits kind:check, that arithmetic reads the floor's own bulk as evidence the ceiling is healthy — the instrument flattering the thing it measures. Its predicate must ASK the floor which kinds it produces rather than spelling 'charter' as a literal, which is the same reification lesson twice in one build.

SHIPPING THE PROBE FIX SEPARATELY WOULD LEAVE A WINDOW WHERE THE INSTRUMENT LIES IN THE BUILD'S FAVOUR. That is why it is not a child. A child that can pass while embodying the parent's failure is not a decomposition; it is a hole with a name.

DISCOVERY AND RUNNING CANNOT PROVE APART, which is why this has no children at all. A floor that discovers instruments and reports them without running them is exactly the briefing this ticket exists to replace — it would pass its own gate while being the defect.

THE REIFICATION WAS CAUGHT AT n=14 AND IT IS RECORDED BECAUSE IT ALMOST SHIPPED. CC arrived with five tidy categories (gates, measurements, precedent, rulings, contracts) and was one step from writing them into the code as a constant. Akien's third clause is the ruling against exactly that, and it is why the set is discovered from disk at fire time.

THE PROXY AND THE MEASURE ARE DIFFERENT AND THE WATCH USES THE MEASURE. The tool-call count is the proxy; the thing is which lookups stop. A floor that answers ten questions nobody asked while missing the one that was asked has moved the proxy and not the thing — which is why the WATCHME does not clear on packets getting bigger.

THE HYPOTHESIS THAT WAS KILLED IS THE ONE THAT PAID FOR ITSELF, AND IT NAMED ITS OWN DEATH IN ADVANCE. EMISSION's falsifier said: 'Falsified more seriously if it PASSES because the source is a string the judge resolves trivially without it naming the check — a source that resolves but does not identify is the laundered-provenance failure in a new place.' Measured at acceptance: judge_constrain returned [] on a packet whose check source had been swapped for the component DIRECTORY, a real path a resolver is happy with. So the expectation that spelling the source in the form the installed judge accepts is SUFFICIENT is false — the installed judge accepts a form it cannot distinguish. Seven hypotheses confirmed, one killed, and the killed one is the only one that changed the code. A chain whose hypotheses all confirm has not told you anything you did not already believe.

THE FIX WENT TO THIS MACHINE'S DOOR AND NOT TO THE SHARED JUDGE, AND THAT IS A BOUNDS DECISION RATHER THAN A DESIGN PREFERENCE. constraint_traces is the corpus-wide judge every constrain packet passes; making it require IDENTITY and not merely resolution would change what every other voyage's packets must satisfy, and constrain's stage-2 bounds put the inspector OUT. So every_check_names_a_discovered_instrument stands at constrain's own door, re-deriving the discovered set for the packet's own intent_ref and refusing a check source outside it. The corpus-wide question is real and it stands at Akien's gate unanswered: SHOULD a source that resolves but does not identify be refused everywhere? Widening the bounds to answer it here would have been the silent widening the chart exists to stop.

TWO DEFECTS WERE FOUND BY RUNNING THE CRITERIA AND ZERO BY READING THE CODE, AND BOTH WERE INVISIBLE TO EVERY PASSING TOOTH. The second is above; the first is that a proof path which vanished between discovery and the run came back {'verdict': 'red', 'how': 'run by the tester'} — python exits non-zero on a file it cannot open, so the VERDICT was defensible while the HOW was a record of truth telling a false story about a file that was never run (Law 7), sending a reader hunting for a failing assertion in a file that does not exist. Neither defect is exotic and neither would have been found by another pass over the source. The instrument is what found them, which is the criterion-with-an-instrument shape doing the exact work it was built for.

THE PROBE READS NOT CLEARED AT ARMING BY CONSTRUCTION, NOT BY A DATE SOMEONE TYPED. lookups_stop's population is derived from THIS TICKET'S OWN PROVED CROSSING, read out of the machine's history.json — so before the crossing landed the population was empty and no clearing clause could be satisfied, and after it landed the cutoff is exact and nobody has to remember to move it. Law 9 satisfied without a special case, and a learned value that never gets stranded in a human's head. Its third clearing clause is the one worth copying: at least one check must ever have been reported RED, because a report that has only said green is indistinguishable from a report that cannot say anything else — which is a constant this very component shipped once already.

WHAT THE WATCH CAN SEE IS CARRIAGE AND THE SUFFICIENT HALF IS DECLARED UNMEASURED. Akien's measure is that the LOOKUPS STOP. Nothing in this system counts a build's tool calls, so the observable is the discovered checks SURVIVING into the berthed packet: necessary, because checks that never reach the packet cannot have replaced a lookup, and not sufficient, because a full packet says nothing about whether the builder read it. The builder is Claude, which is Law 10's one standing exception. The gap is stated in the probe's carry, in the charter's filed edges and in the verdict artifact rather than left for a reader to discover — and the instrument that would close it is ticket the-builds-tool-calls-are-evidence-about-the-chart.

THE CRITERION'S CLAIM TEXT REACHED FURTHER THAN ITS OWN INSTRUMENT COULD AT A CROSSING, AND THAT IS A FINDING ABOUT THE VALIDATE LEG. Criterion 1 claims the lookups actually stop; its instrument can only read an armed probe plus the escalation clause. The verdict door takes pass|fail and a fail is a kick-back, so the claim was answered against what its instrument could measure at the crossing — the escalation clause did not fire — with the evidence field carrying the limit explicitly rather than the outcome field carrying a lie. The general shape, for the next chart: a criterion whose claim spans a WATCHME window needs its crossing-time half spelled IN THE CLAIM, or the verdict artifact is forced to choose between kicking back a finished build and overstating what was seen.
